## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and why the change is needed.

## Verification

List the checks, tests, platforms, and manual flows used to verify the change.

## Risk and rollout

Describe compatibility concerns, migrations, deployment considerations, or follow-up work. Write `None` when there are none.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no secrets or private data.
- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior.
- [ ] Documentation and public API notes are updated where needed.
- [ ] `just pre-push` passes locally, or any environment-specific limitation is explained above.
- [ ] Breaking changes are clearly identified and justified.
